cases.spec_ref: `lat validate --json` renders findings through a HAND-SYNCED renderer triplicated across the three launchers (laterite-py lib.rs, laterite-node lib.rs 'ported verbatim', render.rs 'byte-identical'). Three hand-synced copies held by discipline is the exact shape that produced drifts #1 and #2 — so the whole render (findings map + exit code) must be byte-identical.
The empty-findings render path — a clean file exits 0 with an empty findings map, identically across launchers.

`lat validate --ndjson` over the same findings fixture as the `--json` case — one flat JSON object per finding per line. `--ndjson` is the ONLY output flag validate honours that no other verb does (a global flag every verb accepts but only validate reads; a silent no-op on diff/read/merge/rules), and it is a SEPARATE renderer (`findings_ndjson`) hand-synced across the three surfaces — so it is pinned in its own right, not assumed covered by `--json`.
